items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for Monday Night Football vs Giants. Najee Harris active for Giants debut.
items.why: Hip injury trending wrong; confirmed inactive pre-MNF.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; boost other Rams pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Davante Adams and remaining LAR WRs.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert likely to miss a few weeks with sprained MCL suffered vs Titans; Zach Ertz signed to practice squad.
items.why: Sprained MCL confirmed by tests; expected multi-week absence.
items.implication: Sit Goedert; TE streamer need; Eagles pass game adjusts.
items.opportunity: Targets to DeVonta Smith, A.J. Brown (if available), or Ertz if elevated; Hurts checkdowns.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels underwent imaging and will consult specialists over next days per team protocol after dislocated left elbow; expected to miss time with Mariota likely starting.
items.why: Re-dislocated left elbow (prior history); non-contact fall; imaging and multi-specialist consults.
items.implication: Sit Daniels multi-weeks; start Mariota streamers; WAS WRs/TEs face QB downgrade.
items.opportunity: Potential short-term boost or volatility for Terry McLaurin, Deebo Samuel, Stefon Diggs.

items.text: Bears coach Ben Johnson says Caleb Williams is week-to-week with a hamstring pull and will miss some time; Tyson Bagent is the backup.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring on scramble; carted off but walking postgame; MRI/tests show avoided major injury but miss time.
items.implication: Sit Williams Week 3+; stream Bagent or waiver QBs; monitor CHI pass-catchers volume.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes for Rome Odunze, DJ Moore, Luther Burden if Bagent starts.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed injured his back Sunday; spent night in NJ, returning to GB; team evaluating treatment and recovery timeframe.
items.why: Back injury; overnight stay, ongoing eval.
items.implication: Monitor practice; potential miss or limited Week 3.
items.opportunity: Boost for Christian Watson, Dontayvion Wicks, Romeo Doubs.

items.text: Charlie Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps, David Njoku (knee) after 11; allowed Oronde Gadsden 29/67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks. Chargers placing both on IR.
items.why: Injuries opened TE snaps/routes mid-game; both to IR per Schefter.
items.implication: Gadsden sudden TE1 opportunity in LAC.
items.opportunity: High route share/TE targets for Gadsden going forward.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12 yesterday. Through 2 weeks opportunities Bucky 36 vs Gainwell 12. Sean Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.why: Clear snap/carry/route separation in TB backfield.
items.implication: Start Bucky confidently as lead back; Gainwell handcuff only.
items.opportunity: High snap share, carries, routes for Irving; goal-line/third-down potential.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in last 31 games) and was punished with playing time. NE offense needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with A.J. Brown out. Both can be true.
items.why: Fumble punishment reduced Stevenson snaps; Brown absence creates need for Henderson juice.
items.implication: Henderson rising; Stevenson riskier; monitor split.
items.opportunity: More carries/routes for Henderson; even split possible on touches.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE after 27% and 38% target shares in first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model lead.
items.implication: Must-start every week; lock in lineups.
items.opportunity: High target volume, especially with Goedert out.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will have MRI after stinger but hope is minor injury; he played through it.
items.why: Stinger suffered but played through; MRI for clarity, optimistic minor.
items.implication: Monitor closely for Week 3; likely plays if minor.
items.opportunity: If limited, Kenny Gainwell or other PHI backs.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket possible); RJ Harvey inactive. Grab Jonah Coleman if ignored preseason.
items.why: Optimism confirmed active; Harvey hamstring not expected/inactive.
items.implication: Start McConkey with confidence; drop/avoid Harvey; stash Coleman as handcuff/beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Full McConkey routes/targets; DEN RB volume to JK Dobbins or others without Harvey.

items.text: Weekend status: GTD Ladd McConkey (optimism, flak) and Puka Nacua (hip); not expected RJ Harvey; expected Olave/Burrow/McMillan (snap count); OUT Zay Flowers (ham) and Michael Pittman (foot).
items.implication: Acted on for Week 2 decisions; later updates (McConkey active, Nacua inactive) supersede.
items.opportunity: Flowers/Pittman OUT open targets (e.g. Ravens/Colts others); Olave/Burrow play.

items.text: Falcons named Michael Penix Jr. starting QB for Thursday vs Packers (first start post-ACL).
items.why: Penix ready after splitting reps; ACL reconstructed deemed good.
items.implication: Potential upgrade in ATL passing volume/efficiency vs prior.
items.opportunity: Boosted targets for Drake London, Kyle Pitts; Bijan still featured.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious by HC Shanahan; could have returned in 4th if needed. Demarcus Robinson high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Hip issue; coach optimistic, playable if needed.
items.opportunity: Full role if cleared; Robinson out 3-6 weeks boosts others.
